observations.behavior: Documentation and metadata update: AdRoll API reference URL and reporting API note. No executable implementation.
observations.code_quote: Note: NextRoll splits reporting into a separate GraphQL Reporting API (https://apidocs.nextroll.com/graphql-reporting-api/index.html) that supersedes the legacy CRUD /api/v1/report/\* endpoints - delivery and attribution metrics by advertisable, campaign, adgroup, ad, plus granular conversions. The synced report tables use the CRUD API's `entity` data format, the only shape that reference documents: one row per entity with its delivery metrics. Per-day breakdowns and attribution remain a GraphQL Reporting API follow-up. The developers.nextroll.com URL in the payload is an Angular shell with no content; the real reference is apidocs.nextroll.com.
